propositions: Four core modules (fetcher, applier, apply_handlers, _attestation) directly import adapters.jira for scalar concerns and must be decoupled to satisfy ADR 0035 vendor-adapter seam requirements.
The Backend protocol must expose scalar, read-only members (project, query_project, assert_env_ready) with neutral semantics to replace vendor-specific adapters.jira dependencies.
Function-nested lazy imports in the four modules require full-tree AST validation (ast.walk) rather than top-level-only inspection to verify complete vendor-import elimination.

BackendEnvError and BackendAssigneeNotFoundError must be defined as neutral exceptions in the port layer, with JiraBackend implementations delegating to resolve_jira_settings and acli_subprocess respectively.
JiraBackend.project must preserve DIG-default semantics for applier cross-project guards, while query_project must preserve un-defaulted fail-closed behavior for fetcher JQL scoping.
The S2 contract suite and FakeBackend must be updated to satisfy the widened Backend protocol, and ADR 0035 section (d) interface table must document the new scalar members and exceptions.
